# PixelHelm atomic skills

- **pixelhelm** - route one admitted frontend-design task.
- **pixelhelm-choicegate** - verify a complete ChoiceGate continuation.
- **pixelhelm-loop** - sequence the core design loop.
- **pixelhelm-ground** - resolve register, tokens, guidance, and lessons.
- **pixelhelm-baseline** - capture the measurable incumbent.
- **pixelhelm-generate** - produce grounded alternatives.
- **pixelhelm-render** - render the browser matrix.
- **pixelhelm-evaluate** - run machine-certain gates.
- **pixelhelm-judge** - synthesize named-lens judgment.
- **pixelhelm-repair** - fix one validated finding.
- **pixelhelm-tokens** - own the token contract.
- **pixelhelm-promote-design** - promote an approved passing candidate.
- **pixelhelm-record-lesson** - record one owner-derived lesson.
- **pixelhelm-refresh-guidance** - refresh time-sensitive guidance.
- **pixelhelm-curate-fingerprints** - curate recurring anti-cliche fingerprints.
- **pixelhelm-reference** - retrieve design references.
- **pixelhelm-directions** - produce owner-selectable mockup directions.
- **pixelhelm-evidence-brief** - produce cited evidence, not UI.
- **pixelhelm-color** - author color roles.
- **pixelhelm-typography** - specify typography.
- **pixelhelm-motion** - specify motion.
- **pixelhelm-dataviz** - design honest data interfaces.
- **pixelhelm-content** - write interface content.
- **pixelhelm-email** - design robust HTML email.
- **pixelhelm-video-placement** - specify safe video placement.
